question: Who among the following authors incorporated the song Vande Mataram into his novel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.**__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's national song, Vande Mataram**, was written by **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.**
 
• It was initially released in his book **Anandamath** (1882).
 
• Vande Mataram is a pair of **Sanskrit verses** written in a very elaborate Bengali script.
 
• It was** designated** as** India's National Song** by the **Constituent Assembly of India in 1950**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay** (also **Chatterjee**) was an Indian novelist, poet, essayist and journalist. Bengali literature refers to him as **'Sahitya Samrat'**, or the** Emperor of Literature**.
 
• **Murugam Periyar** was a social reformer from Tamil Nadu who worked for the upliftment of the lower castes and the eradication of social evils like untouchability. He is known as the** 'Father of the Dravidian movement'.**
 
• **Lal Makhan Singh** was a **Kenyan labor union leader** of Punjabi descent who is recognized for having laid the groundwork for trade unionism in that country. He is also known as **'Gujaratana Pita' (Father of Gujarat)** in Gujarat and Maharaja Nairobi in Kenya
